# IronCell Research

> US supplier of research-grade peptides for laboratory research use only. Certificates of analysis (COAs) are published for the batches that carry them. Products are not for human consumption, not dietary supplements, and not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

## What IronCell Research is

- Online store at https://ironcellresearch.com/ selling research peptides and laboratory supplies to qualified researchers in the United States.
- Research use only (RUO): all compounds are sold strictly as laboratory reagents for in-vitro research.
- Quality proof: COAs published for the batches that carry them; transparent sourcing.
- Fast US shipping on research supplies.
- Laboratory supplies stocked alongside the catalog: bacteriostatic water (including 30ml), 31 gauge insulin syringes, alcohol prep pads, and starter kits.
